english.title: Manufacture for sale / hire a device / product / component designed to circumvent technological measures
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) manufactured for sale or hire a

(A)_[device,]_
(B)_[product,]_
(C)_[component,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEVICE / PRODUCT / COMPONENT..), which was primarily designed, produced or adapted for the purpose of enabling or facilitating the circumvention of effective technological measures
english.legislation: Contrary to section 296ZB(1)(a) and (4) of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
manufactured for sale / hire a device / product / component
which was primarily designed / produced / adapted for the purpose of
enabling / facilitating the circumvention of effective technological measures

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: It is not enough that the technological measure is a discouragement or general commercial hindrance to copyright infringement, it must be a measure which physically prevents it. (R v Higgs 2008) EWCA Crim 1324 [2009] and 1 WLR 73, [2008].

welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 296ZB(1)(a) a (4) Deddf Hawlfraint, Dyluniadau a Phatentau 1988.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
